question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/list request (jsonrpc 2.0, empty params) sent as its own request: no credential, no Mcp-Session-Id header, and no initialize on this connection

decoded.tools: eight, counted by occurrences of "inputSchema" over the whole response: aws___get_presigned_url, aws___get_tasks, aws___run_script, aws___get_regional_availability, aws___list_regions, aws___read_documentation, aws___retrieve_skill, aws___search_documentation
decoded.statelessness: the server answered a tools/list that followed no handshake on this connection, and issued no session id in the response
decoded.challenge: no WWW-Authenticate header, and the response did not answer 401
decoded.annotations: aws___run_script declares destructiveHint true and readOnlyHint false; aws___get_presigned_url declares readOnlyHint false; the other six declare readOnlyHint true
decoded.client-specific-hint: aws___run_script carries _meta.anthropic/alwaysLoad true, a tool-loading hint addressed to one named client, published in the list to every caller
decoded.handshake-variant: a keyless initialize at 06:11Z answered 200 as AWSMCP 1.0.0, protocol 2025-06-18, and a tools/list on that session returned the same eight tools; sections 1 and 1b of the transcript
decoded.not-measured: six of the eight tools were not called: run_script, get_presigned_url and get_tasks were declined, because calling them means asking someone else's infrastructure to execute code or mint a signed URL, and read_documentation, retrieve_skill and get_regional_availability were simply not exercised. Only search_documentation and list_regions were called, in separate records

finding: An unauthenticated caller that sends no handshake at all is given this server's whole advertised tool set: eight tools with their full input schemas, including aws___run_script ("Execute Python code in sandboxed environment with AWS API access", destructiveHint true) and aws___get_presigned_url. No WWW-Authenticate header, no 401, and no session needed for the listing. The vendor's setup page documents two authentication methods, OAuth or SigV4, and the GA announcement carves out one exception, that "documentation search and skill discovery no longer require AWS credentials". The list an unauthenticated caller receives is not limited to that exception. Being listed a tool is not being entitled to run it, and this record does not claim otherwise: what is established is that the advertisement, including the schemas of the credentialed tools, is public.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -i -m 40 -X POST https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'
